text:
Picked up during /do-beads pass but escalating per bead's own instruction ('label this human if not resolved when picked up'). The design question (a/b/c for where max-* config values live) is unresolved.

The bead's recommendation is option (c): backend method limits() returning a ChatLimits struct, matching how Email/import limits work in jmap-mail-server. I agree with that recommendation — it keeps the policy with the backend (which already owns per-account permission state), avoids a new session-capability surface that would ripple through jmap-server foundation, and parallels precedent already in the workspace.

If approved, the implementation steps in the bead description are concrete and ready to execute. Filing this comment instead of claiming-and-implementing because the bead author explicitly asked for human confirmation before the work starts.
